name: TFA Email OTP Plugin
description: A TFA Email OTP plugin working with TFA module.
project_description:
This module provides a TFA plugin to send an One-Time password (code) via email.

Which is required by Create "Email one-time-code" Validation Plugin & related Setup Plugin 

 Post-Installation 
 It is a TFA plugin, which means it requires TFA module and its dependencies installed.

 Migration 
 If you migrated the email plugin from the patch ( https://www.drupal.org/project/tfa/issues/2930541 ), it is highly recommended using Drush to install this module to prevent a potential time-out error during the installation. Also, you have to make sure you clear the cache after installing this module and then remove the patch from your codebase(composer.json).

 Supporting this Module 
 You can support this module by reporting bugs with this module.
